passes.captionZh: 长笛吹出日出的旋律，弦乐轻轻铺着
passes.captionEn: The flute plays the sunrise tune over soft strings

passes.captionZh: 双簧管接过来，同样的旋律再唱一遍
passes.captionEn: The oboe answers with the same tune

passes.captionZh: 长笛和双簧管又一来一回，太阳升高了一点
passes.captionEn: Flute and oboe trade it again; the sun climbs a little

passes.captionZh: 弦乐全体把旋律唱得又宽又亮，圆号和大管托着
passes.captionEn: All the strings sing it broad and bright; horns and bassoons underneath

passes.captionZh: 最后长笛轻轻再吹一句，像早晨安静下来
passes.captionEn: At the end the flute plays it once more, quietly

str.zh: 先轻轻铺着长音，后来全体弦乐把旋律唱得又宽又亮。
str.en: They lay soft long notes first; later all the strings sing the tune broad and bright.

ww.zh: 长笛和双簧管一来一回地吹日出的旋律。
ww.en: Flute and oboe trade the sunrise tune back and forth.

br.zh: 圆号在后半段托着和声，像太阳完全升起来。
br.en: Horns hold the harmony in the second half, as the sun fully rises.

perc.zh: 只有一下很轻的定音鼓。
